events.title: Qorvo (NASDAQ:QRVO) Q1: Beats On Revenue But Inventory Levels Increase
events.body: Communications chips maker Qorvo (NASDAQ: QRVO) announced better-than-expected revenue in Q1 CY2026, but sales fell by 7% year on year to $808.3 million. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.69 per share was 39.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

events.title: Skyworks Solutions (SWKS) Q2 Earnings and Revenues Beat Estimates
events.body: Skyworks (SWKS) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +10.73% and +4.84%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
